name: Hotel Raj
address: Post Office Road, Koraput, Odisha 764020, India
blurb: Centrally located on Post Office Road — also known as Hotel Raj Residency. Walkable to Sabar Srikhetra temple and Tribal Museum, with 29 rooms, restaurant, and conference facilities.
reviewBody: Guests mention the convenient town-centre location near Sabar Srikhetra and Koraput Junction. Helpful for temple visits and district travel.

name: Atithi Bhawan
address: Poda Line, near Sabar Srikhetra, Koraput, Odisha 764020, India
blurb: Guest house run near Sabar Srikhetra (Jagannath temple). Peaceful hill-side setting, popular with pilgrims and budget travellers.
reviewBody: Ideal if you want to stay close to the Jagannath temple. Railway and bus stands are within about 1–2 km.

name: Hotel Alishan
address: Jeypore Road, near Circuit House, Koraput, Odisha 764020, India
blurb: Odisha Tourism hotel on Jeypore Road near Circuit House. Reliable mid-range option for families and government travellers visiting Koraput.
reviewBody: Well-known government tourism hotel with a convenient location on the main Jeypore Road corridor.

name: Hotel Mount Heaven
address: Block Office, Infront of Stadium Road, Koraput, Odisha 764020, India
blurb: Established Koraput hotel opposite the stadium road block office area. Practical choice for short business and leisure stays.
reviewBody: Easy access to central Koraput with basic comforts for travellers exploring the hill district.

name: Hotel Aurovalley
address: Sri Aurobindo Nagar, near SLN Medical College, Koraput, Odisha 764020, India
blurb: Popular Koraput hotel near SLN Medical College. Guests praise service, cleanliness, and proximity to Tribal Museum and Sabar Srikhetra.
reviewBody: Frequently recommended for families and business visitors. Free Wi‑Fi, parking, and room service available.

name: Raj Residency
address: Post Office Road, Koraput, Odisha 764020, India
blurb: The House of Comfort on Post Office Road with 29 rooms, restaurant, laundry, and 24/7 security — 9 minutes walk from Tribal Museum.
reviewBody: One of the most reviewed hotels in Koraput town. Close to Sabar Srikhetra and Koraput Junction.

name: Hotel Sri Krishna
blurb: Budget-friendly hotel favoured by business travellers and repeat visitors to Koraput. Functional rooms with essentials near transport links.
reviewBody: Affordable option with decent rooms and easy access to shops and transport in Koraput town.

name: Hotel Sabar Inn
address: Plot No. 266/580, Chappar Mouza, Koraput, Odisha 764020, India
blurb: 3-star hotel on Chappar Mouza near NH corridor. Restaurant, free Wi‑Fi, parking, and terrace — about 18 minutes walk from Jagannath Temple.
reviewBody: Comfortable rooms with restaurant and business facilities, suited for families visiting Koraput and nearby sights.

name: Maa Mangala Residency
address: Jaipur Road, NH-26, near Maa Batamangala Temple, Koraput, Odisha 764020, India
blurb: Residency on Jaipur Road (NH-26) near Maa Batamangala Temple. Budget to mid-range tariffs for pilgrims and highway travellers.
reviewBody: Convenient for travellers on the Jaipur Road highway with affordable room options in Koraput town.

name: Krishna Homestay
address: Housing Board Colony, near Kendriya Vidyalaya, Pujariput, Koraput, Odisha 764020, India
blurb: Homestay in Pujariput near Kendriya Vidyalaya. Warm local hospitality and excellent proximity to Koraput sights.
reviewBody: Guests appreciate the personal service and quiet residential neighbourhood close to town attractions.
